####################################################################################################
Purpose of script: To estimate population mean immunogenicity under different 
vaccination ages and a targeted delay during the valley season
####################################################################################################

# Set up

```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("../00_pck.R")
source("../00_dirs.R")

theme_set(theme_classic() + theme(strip.background = element_blank()))
```

# Read in files 

```{r}
imm_files <- list.files(glue("{dirs$modres}/modresimm_population"), full.names = TRUE) %>%
  str_subset("/imm_.*_age[0-9]+to[0-9]+_draw[0-9]+[.]rds$")

dat_cov <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$modres}/modresimm_population/dat_cov.rds"))

dat_phase <- readRDS(file = glue("{dirs$modres}/wbest_phisumm.rds")) %>%
  filter(mod %in% dat_cov$mod_best) %>%
  mutate(min_week = round(((phi_mean - 1 + 26) %% 52) + 1)) %>%
  select(pat, mod_best = mod, clu, min_week) %>%
  mutate(clu = str_remove_all(as.character(clu), " ")) %>%
  distinct()
```

# Baseline simulations 

```{r}
sim_baseline <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(dat_cov)), \(x) {
  pomp::bake(paste0(dirs$modres, "/modresimm_population/sim_baseline_", dat_cov$mod_best[x]), dir = "", {
    # Select on model 
    mod_x <- dat_cov$mod_best[x]
    message(glue("Estimating population immunogenicity: {mod_x}"))
    # Immunogenicity 
    path_imm <- imm_files[str_starts(basename(imm_files),
                                      fixed(paste0("imm_", str_remove(mod_x, "[.]rds$"), "_age")))]
    stopifnot(length(path_imm) == 1)
    dat_imm <- readRDS(path_imm)
    stopifnot(all(is.finite(dat_imm$imm)), !anyNA(dat_imm$draw))
    dat_phase_x <- dat_phase %>%
      filter(mod_best == mod_x) %>%
      semi_join(distinct(dat_imm, pat, mod_best, clu), by = join_by(pat, mod_best, clu))
    
    # Simulation baseline 
    dat_pop <- dat_phase_x %>%
      crossing(birth_week = c(1:52), age_ini = unique(dat_imm$age), sex = c("F", "M")) %>%
      mutate(vac_week_v1_ini = ((birth_week - 1 + age_ini) %% 52) + 1,
             n = 1000 / 2) %>%
        mutate(scenario = "baseline",
           bad_season = FALSE,
           delay = 0,
           vac_week_v1 = if_else(bad_season, ((vac_week_v1_ini + delay - 1) %% 52) + 1, vac_week_v1_ini),
           age = if_else(bad_season, age_ini + delay, age_ini))
    
    # Bind and summarise 
    left_join(dat_pop, dat_imm, by = join_by(pat, mod_best, clu, sex, vac_week_v1, age)) %>%
      group_by(scenario, pat, mod_best, clu, min_week, age_ini, draw, delay) %>%
      summarise(imm_pop = sum(n * imm) / sum(n), .groups = "drop") %>%
      group_by(scenario, pat, mod_best, clu, min_week, age_ini, delay) %>%
      summarise(imm_pop_mean = mean(imm_pop),
                imm_pop_med  = median(imm_pop),
                imm_pop_cilo = quantile(imm_pop, 0.025),
                imm_pop_ciup = quantile(imm_pop, 0.975),
                .groups = "drop")
  })
})
```

# 12 Weeks more simulations

The targeted period includes the minimum week and the following 12 weeks.
Immunogenicity is the population-weighted mean expected antibody response, in the model response units.
Absolute differences retain these units; ratios and percentage increases are calculated within posterior draws.

```{r}
sim_delay12more <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(dat_cov)), \(x) {
  pomp::bake(paste0(dirs$modres, "/modresimm_population/sim_delay12more_ratio_", dat_cov$mod_best[x]), dir = "", {
    # Select on model 
    mod_x <- dat_cov$mod_best[x]
    message(glue("Estimating population immunogenicity: {mod_x}"))
    
    # Immunogenicity 
    path_imm <- imm_files[str_starts(basename(imm_files),
                                      fixed(paste0("imm_", str_remove(mod_x, "[.]rds$"), "_age")))]
    stopifnot(length(path_imm) == 1)
    dat_imm <- readRDS(path_imm)
    stopifnot(all(is.finite(dat_imm$imm)), !anyNA(dat_imm$draw))
    dat_phase_x <- dat_phase %>%
      filter(mod_best == mod_x) %>%
      semi_join(distinct(dat_imm, pat, mod_best, clu), by = join_by(pat, mod_best, clu))
    
    # Baseline population --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    dat_pop_baseline <- dat_phase_x %>%
      crossing(birth_week = 1:52, age_ini = unique(dat_imm$age), sex = c("F", "M")) %>%
      mutate(vac_week_v1 = ((birth_week - 1 + age_ini) %% 52) + 1, 
             age = age_ini,
             n = 1000 / 2)
    
    # Baseline immunogenicity for every posterior draw
    imm_pop_base_draws <- dat_pop_baseline %>%
      left_join(dat_imm, by = join_by(pat, mod_best, clu, sex, vac_week_v1, age)) %>%
      group_by(pat, mod_best, clu, min_week, age_ini, draw) %>%
      summarise(imm_pop_baseline = sum(n * imm) / sum(n), .groups = "drop")
    
    # Baseline recommended later immunogenicity for every posterior draw 
    # Same later-age comparator as 03_04_06: 8 weeks for infants and 52 otherwise
    age_late_x <- if_else(dat_cov$age_fixed[x] == 8, 8, 52)
    
    imm_pop_late_draws <- imm_pop_base_draws %>%
      filter(age_ini == age_late_x) %>%
      select(pat, mod_best, clu, min_week, draw, imm_pop_late = imm_pop_baseline)
    
    # Define delay 
    delay_l <- if(dat_cov$age_fixed[x] == 8) 1:8 else 1:26
    
    # Scenario population --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    dat_pop <- dat_phase_x %>%
      crossing(birth_week = c(1:52), age_ini = unique(dat_imm$age), sex = c("F", "M")) %>%
      mutate(vac_week_v1_ini = ((birth_week - 1 + age_ini) %% 52) + 1,
             n = 1000 / 2) %>%
      mutate(scenario = "delay12more",
             bad_season = ((vac_week_v1_ini - min_week) %% 52) <= 12) %>%
      crossing(delay = delay_l) %>%
      mutate(vac_week_v1 = if_else(bad_season, ((vac_week_v1_ini + delay - 1) %% 52) + 1, vac_week_v1_ini),
             age = if_else(bad_season, age_ini + delay, age_ini))
  
    # Immunogenicity -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    imm_pop_draws <- map_dfr(delay_l, \(delay_x) {
      dat_pop_x <- filter(dat_pop, delay == delay_x, age_ini <= max(dat_imm$age) - delay_x)

      # Immunogenicity only among targeted children
      imm_target_delay <- dat_pop_x %>%
        filter(bad_season) %>%
        left_join(
          dat_imm,
          by = join_by(pat, mod_best, clu, sex, vac_week_v1, age),
          relationship = "many-to-many"
        ) %>%
        group_by(pat, mod_best, clu, min_week, age_ini, draw, delay) %>%
        summarise(
          imm_target_delay = sum(n * imm) / sum(n),
          .groups = "drop"
        )
      
      imm_target_base <- dat_pop_x %>%
        filter(bad_season) %>%
        mutate(
          vac_week_v1 = vac_week_v1_ini,
          age = age_ini
        ) %>%
        left_join(
          dat_imm,
          by = join_by(pat, mod_best, clu, sex, vac_week_v1, age),
          relationship = "many-to-many"
        ) %>%
        group_by(pat, mod_best, clu, min_week, age_ini, draw, delay) %>%
        summarise(
          imm_target_base = sum(n * imm) / sum(n),
          .groups = "drop"
        )
        imm_target <- imm_target_delay %>%
          left_join(
            imm_target_base,
            by = join_by(
              pat, mod_best, clu, min_week,
              age_ini, draw, delay
            )
          ) %>%
          mutate(
            increasepct_target =
              100 * (imm_target_delay / imm_target_base - 1)
          )
        
        imm_target_summ <- imm_target %>%
          group_by(
            pat, mod_best, clu, min_week,
            age_ini, delay
          ) %>%
          summarise(
            increasepct_target_mean = mean(increasepct_target, na.rm = TRUE),
            increasepct_target_cilo = quantile(increasepct_target, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
            increasepct_target_ciup = quantile(increasepct_target, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop"
          )
      # Immunogenicity under the delayed scenario by draw
      imm_pop_scenario_draws <- dat_pop_x %>%
        left_join(dat_imm, by = join_by(pat, mod_best, clu, sex, vac_week_v1, age),
                  relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
        group_by(scenario, pat, mod_best, clu, min_week, age_ini, draw, delay) %>%
        summarise(imm_pop = sum(n * imm) / sum(n), .groups = "drop")

      # Calculate comparisons within matched posterior draws
      ratio_draws <- imm_pop_scenario_draws %>%
        left_join(imm_pop_base_draws, by = join_by(pat, mod_best, clu, min_week, age_ini, draw)) %>%
        left_join(imm_pop_late_draws, by = join_by(pat, mod_best, clu, min_week, draw)) %>%
        mutate(
          absdiff_sl_draw = imm_pop - imm_pop_late,
          
          absdiff_bl_draw = imm_pop_late - imm_pop_baseline,
          ratio_bl_draw = imm_pop_late / imm_pop_baseline,
          increasepct_bl_draw = 100 * (ratio_bl_draw - 1),
          
          absdiff_bs_draw = imm_pop - imm_pop_baseline,
          ratio_bs_draw = imm_pop / imm_pop_baseline,
          increasepct_bs_draw = 100 * (ratio_bs_draw - 1),
          
          gapclosed_bls_draw = (imm_pop - imm_pop_baseline) / (imm_pop_late - imm_pop_baseline),
          gapclosedpct_bls_draw = 100 * gapclosed_bls_draw) %>%
        mutate(across(c(
          absdiff_sl_draw,
          absdiff_bl_draw, ratio_bl_draw, increasepct_bl_draw, 
          absdiff_bs_draw, ratio_bs_draw, increasepct_bs_draw, 
          gapclosed_bls_draw, gapclosedpct_bls_draw),
          ~ if_else(is.finite(.x), .x, NA_real_)))
      
      # Summarise posterior distributions
      imm_pop_summ <- ratio_draws %>%
        group_by(scenario, pat, mod_best, clu, min_week, age_ini, delay) %>%
        summarise(

          imm_pop_mean = mean(imm_pop, na.rm = TRUE),
          imm_pop_med = median(imm_pop, na.rm = TRUE),
          imm_pop_cilo = quantile(imm_pop, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
          imm_pop_ciup = quantile(imm_pop, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
          
          absdiff_sl_mean = mean(absdiff_sl_draw, na.rm = TRUE),
          absdiff_sl_med = median(absdiff_sl_draw, na.rm = TRUE),
          absdiff_sl_cilo = quantile(absdiff_sl_draw, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
          absdiff_sl_ciup = quantile(absdiff_sl_draw, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
          
          absdiff_bl_mean = mean(absdiff_bl_draw, na.rm = TRUE),
          absdiff_bl_med = median(absdiff_bl_draw, na.rm = TRUE),
          absdiff_bl_cilo = quantile(absdiff_bl_draw, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
          absdiff_bl_ciup = quantile(absdiff_bl_draw, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
          ratio_bl_mean = mean(ratio_bl_draw, na.rm = TRUE),
          ratio_bl_med = median(ratio_bl_draw, na.rm = TRUE),
          ratio_bl_cilo = quantile(ratio_bl_draw, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
          ratio_bl_ciup = quantile(ratio_bl_draw, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
          increasepct_bl_mean = mean(increasepct_bl_draw, na.rm = TRUE),
          increasepct_bl_med = median(increasepct_bl_draw, na.rm = TRUE),
          increasepct_bl_cilo = quantile(increasepct_bl_draw, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
          increasepct_bl_ciup = quantile(increasepct_bl_draw, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
          
          absdiff_bs_mean = mean(absdiff_bs_draw, na.rm = TRUE),
          absdiff_bs_med = median(absdiff_bs_draw, na.rm = TRUE),
          absdiff_bs_cilo = quantile(absdiff_bs_draw, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
          absdiff_bs_ciup = quantile(absdiff_bs_draw, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
          ratio_bs_mean = mean(ratio_bs_draw, na.rm = TRUE),
          ratio_bs_med = median(ratio_bs_draw, na.rm = TRUE),
          ratio_bs_cilo = quantile(ratio_bs_draw, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
          ratio_bs_ciup = quantile(ratio_bs_draw, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
          increasepct_bs_mean = mean(increasepct_bs_draw, na.rm = TRUE),
          increasepct_bs_med = median(increasepct_bs_draw, na.rm = TRUE),
          increasepct_bs_cilo = quantile(increasepct_bs_draw, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
          increasepct_bs_ciup = quantile(increasepct_bs_draw, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
          
          gapclosed_bls_mean = mean(gapclosed_bls_draw, na.rm = TRUE),
          gapclosed_bls_med = median(gapclosed_bls_draw, na.rm = TRUE),
          gapclosed_bls_cilo = quantile(gapclosed_bls_draw, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
          gapclosed_bls_ciup = quantile(gapclosed_bls_draw, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
          gapclosedpct_bls_mean = mean(gapclosedpct_bls_draw, na.rm = TRUE),
          gapclosedpct_bls_med = median(gapclosedpct_bls_draw, na.rm = TRUE),
          gapclosedpct_bls_cilo = quantile(gapclosedpct_bls_draw, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
          gapclosedpct_bls_ciup = quantile(gapclosedpct_bls_draw, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
          .groups = "drop")
      
      imm_pop_summ %>%
        left_join(imm_target_summ, by = join_by(pat, mod_best, clu, min_week, age_ini, delay))
      
    })
    
    return(imm_pop_draws)
  })
})
```

# Plots ============================================================================================

# One example 

```{r}
mod_x <- "bmv1_semeth_s08_vzv_csi_reg_4.rds"

path_imm <- imm_files[str_starts(basename(imm_files), fixed(
  paste0("imm_", str_remove(mod_x, "[.]rds$"), "_age")))]
dat_imm <- readRDS(path_imm)

dat_phase_x <- dat_phase %>%
  filter(mod_best == mod_x) %>%
  semi_join(distinct(dat_imm, pat, mod_best, clu), by = join_by(pat, mod_best, clu))
delay_l <- 1:26

dat_pop <- dat_phase_x %>%
  crossing(birth_week = c(1:52), age_ini = unique(dat_imm$age), sex = c("F", "M")) %>%
  mutate(vac_week_v1_ini = ((birth_week - 1 + age_ini) %% 52) + 1,
         n = 1000 / 2) %>%
  mutate(scenario = "delay12more",
         bad_season = ((vac_week_v1_ini - min_week) %% 52) <= 12) %>%
  crossing(delay = delay_l) %>%
  mutate(vac_week_v1 = if_else(bad_season, ((vac_week_v1_ini + delay - 1) %% 52) + 1, vac_week_v1_ini),
         age = if_else(bad_season, age_ini + delay, age_ini))

dat_pop_x <- filter(dat_pop, delay == 13)

dat_pop_baseline <- dat_phase_x %>%
  crossing(birth_week = 1:52, age_ini = unique(dat_imm$age), sex = c("F", "M")) %>%
  mutate(vac_week_v1 = ((birth_week - 1 + age_ini) %% 52) + 1,
         age = age_ini,
         n = 1000 / 2)

# Immunogenicity under the delayed scenario by draw
test_delay <- dat_pop_x %>%
  filter(age_ini %in% c(38), sex == "M", clu == "1_Temperate") %>%
  left_join(dat_imm, by = join_by(pat, mod_best, clu, sex, vac_week_v1, age),
            relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  mutate(scenario = "Seasonally targeted delay")

test_baseline <- dat_pop_baseline %>%
  filter(age %in% c(38), sex == "M", clu == "1_Temperate") %>%
  left_join(dat_imm, by = join_by(pat, mod_best, clu, sex, vac_week_v1, age)) %>%
  mutate(scenario = "Everyone early") %>%
  bind_rows(
    dat_pop_baseline %>%
    filter(age %in% c(52), sex == "M", clu == "1_Temperate") %>%
    left_join(dat_imm, by = join_by(pat, mod_best, clu, sex, vac_week_v1, age)) %>%
    mutate(scenario = "Everyone later")
  ) %>%
  bind_rows(test_delay) %>%
  group_by(vac_week_v1, scenario, draw) %>%
  summarise(imm = sum(n * imm) / sum(n), n = sum(n), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(vac_week_v1, scenario) %>%
  summarise(n = first(n),
            imm_up = quantile(imm, 0.975),
            imm_lo = quantile(imm, 0.025),
            imm = mean(imm), .groups = "drop")
```

# Figure 5 ---------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r}
# Plot for figure 5b
figimm_l <- list()
figimm_l$a1 <- test_baseline %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = vac_week_v1, y = imm, color = scenario)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_continuous("Week of vaccination", breaks = c(1,18,35,52), limits = c(1,52), expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_y_continuous("Mean immunogenicity") +
  scale_color_manual("Scenario", values = c("#21908CFF","grey", "#440154FF"), guide = guide_legend(nrow = 2)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.line.x = element_blank(), axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), axis.title.y = element_blank()) +
  guides(color = "none", fill = "none", shape = "none", linetype = "none")

figimm_l$a2 <- test_baseline %>%
  mutate(scenario_y = as.numeric(factor(
    scenario, levels = c("Everyone later", "Everyone early", "Seasonally targeted delay")))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = vac_week_v1, y = scenario_y, fill = scenario)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_x_continuous("Week of vaccination", breaks = c(1,18,35,52), limits = c(1,52), expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = 1:3, labels = c("Everyone later", "Everyone early", "Seasonally targeted delay"), 
                     expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#21908CFF", "grey", "#440154FF"), guide = guide_legend(nrow = 2)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.title.y.left = element_blank(), 
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent")) + 
  guides(color = "none", fill = "none", shape = "none", linetype = "none") 

figimm_l$a <- figimm_l$a1/ figimm_l$a2 + plot_layout(heights = c(6,1))

figimm_l$a <- figimm_l$a1 /
  patchwork::free(figimm_l$a2 , type = "space", side = "l") +
  plot_layout(heights = c(6, 1))
```

# Prepare data for plot 
```{r}
pldat <- list()
mmrv <- c("measl", "mumps", "rubel", "vzv")

pldat$baseline <- sim_baseline %>%
  mutate(mmrvhav = case_when(pat %in% mmrv ~ 1, !(pat %in% c(mmrv, "hav")) ~ 2, pat == "hav" ~ 3),
    age_min = case_when(mmrvhav == 1 ~ 38, mmrvhav == 2 ~ 6, mmrvhav == 3 ~ 51),
    age_rec = case_when(mmrvhav == 1 ~ 52, mmrvhav == 2 ~ 8, mmrvhav == 3 ~ 52)) %>%
  left_join(tidy_names_pat, by = join_by(pat)) %>%
  left_join(tidy_names_clu, by = join_by(clu)) 

pldat$delay12more <- list()
pldat$delay12more <- sim_delay12more %>%
  left_join(pldat$baseline %>% distinct(pat, age_min, age_rec, mmrvhav), by = join_by(pat)) %>%
  left_join(tidy_names_pat, by = join_by(pat)) %>%
  left_join(tidy_names_clu, by = join_by(clu)) %>%
  filter(age_ini <= age_rec & age_ini >= age_min)
```

# Plots
```{r}
figimm_l$b <- pldat$delay12more %>%
  filter((mmrvhav == 1 & age_ini %in% c(38) & delay %in% seq(5, 26, by = 4)) | 
         (mmrvhav == 2 & age_ini %in% c(6) & delay <= 8) |
         (mmrvhav == 3 & age_ini %in% c(51) & delay %in% seq(5, 26, by = 4))) %>%
  select(scenario, pat, mod_best, clu, min_week, age_ini, delay, starts_with("increasepct"), pat_tidy, clu_tidy) %>%
  mutate(pat_tidy = factor(pat_tidy, levels = c(
    "VZV", "Measles", "Rubella", "HAV", "Rotavirus", "Diphteria", "Polio (I) 1", "H. inf B",  
    "N. men C", "S. pn 04", "HBV", "Tetanus", "Pertu (W) PT", "Mumps")))  %>%
  filter(str_detect(mod_best, "semeth", negate = TRUE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = delay, y = increasepct_bs_mean)) + 
  geom_point(aes(x = 0, y = 0, shape = reorder(as.factor(age_ini), age_ini), color = "Everyone early (reference)")) +
  geom_rect(aes(ymin = increasepct_bl_cilo, ymax = increasepct_bl_ciup, xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, fill = "Everyone later"), 
            color = "transparent", alpha = 0.03) + 
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 0, color = "Everyone early (reference)")) + 
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = increasepct_bl_med, color = "Everyone later")) + 
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = increasepct_bs_cilo, ymax = increasepct_bs_ciup, color = "Seasonally targeted delay")) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = reorder(as.factor(age_ini), age_ini), color = "Seasonally targeted delay")) + 
  scale_color_manual(name = "Scenario", values = c(
    "Everyone early (reference)" = "#21908CFF", "Seasonally targeted delay" = "#440154FF", "Everyone later" = "grey")) + 
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Scenario", values =c("Everyone later" = "grey"), guide = "none") +
  scale_shape_manual(name = "Early vaccination age (weeks)", values = c(17, 15, 16)) + 
  scale_x_continuous("Delay among targeted children (weeks)") + 
  scale_y_continuous("Change in population mean immunogenicity (%)") + 
  facet_nested_wrap(pat_tidy+clu_tidy~., scales = "free", solo_line = TRUE, nest_line = TRUE, ncol = 6) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 1, order = 1), shape = guide_legend(ncol = 1, order = 2)) +
  theme(legend.position = "inside",  legend.position.inside = c(0.75,0.08), legend.box = "horizontal")
```

# Save results and plots
```{r}
library(cowplot)
figimm_l$c <- readRDS(paste0(dirs$modres, "/figve_temp.rds"))
figimm_l$c <- figimm_l$c + theme(legend.position = "right", legend.justification = c(0, 1), legend.title = element_blank())
figimm_l$pl_top <- ggdraw() +
  draw_plot(figimm_l$c, x = 0, y = 0, width = 0.55, height = 1) +
  draw_plot(figimm_l$a, x = 0.55, y = 0, width = 0.45, height = 1)

# Figure 5
figimm_l$fg <- figimm_l$pl_top / free(figimm_l$b) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 2.3))

# Save the plot
ggsave(glue("../{dirs$figures}/fig5.pdf"), figimm_l$fg, width = 9, height = 12)
```

# Check results 

```{r}
res_report <- pldat$delay12more %>%
  filter((mmrvhav == 1 & age_ini == 38) | (mmrvhav == 2 & age_ini == 6) | (mmrvhav == 3 & age_ini == 51)) %>%
  group_by(pat, clu) %>%
  filter(gapclosedpct_bls_mean >= 100) %>%
  slice_min(delay, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

# Increase from vaccinating everyone later
res_report %>%
  summarise(min = min(increasepct_bl_mean, na.rm = TRUE), 
            max = max(increasepct_bl_mean, na.rm = TRUE))

# Percentage of the later-age gain recovered by targeted vaccination
res_report %>%
  summarise(min = min(gapclosedpct_bls_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
            max = max(gapclosedpct_bls_mean, na.rm = TRUE))

# Percentage of the later-age gain recovered by targeted vaccination
res_report %>%
  summarise(min = min(increasepct_target_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
            max = max(increasepct_target_mean, na.rm = TRUE))
```
